description: The single, canonical definition of 'partial' for a run, independent of runs.status by construction (ADR-016 / 05_reporting.module_spec.json invariant: 'is_partial has exactly one definition'). Every other place that needs to know whether a run is partial calls this rather than re-deriving it.
docstring:
Determine whether a run's stage set counts as partial.

Args:
    stages: storage.read_run_stages(conn, run_id) output, in any order.

Returns:
    True unless stages contains a 'succeeded' entry for all three of 'acquisition', 'enrichment' and 'analysis'. Equivalently: False iff {s.stage for s in stages if s.status == 'succeeded'} == {'acquisition', 'enrichment', 'analysis'}.
postconditions: Result depends only on stages, never on any runs.status value
A stage present with a non-'succeeded' status counts the same as a stage entirely absent -- both make the result True

edge_cases.input: All three stages present with status='succeeded'
All three present but one has status='failed'
An extra, unrecognized stage name present alongside all three succeeded (e.g. a future stage added later without updating this function)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: still False -- the check is that the required three are all succeeded, not that the set is exactly equal to stages; an extra unknown stage does not itself make a run partial

edge_cases.input: Duplicate RunStage entries for the same stage name (should not occur given the (run_id, stage) primary key, but not structurally prevented for a hand-built list in a test)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: set-based comparison naturally deduplicates; result unaffected

unit_tests.name: test_all_succeeded_is_not_partial
unit_tests.description: Three RunStage entries, all status='succeeded', returns False.

unit_tests.name: test_empty_stages_is_partial
unit_tests.description: An empty stages list returns True.

unit_tests.name: test_one_failed_stage_is_partial
unit_tests.description: Two succeeded, one failed, returns True.

unit_tests.name: test_extra_unknown_stage_does_not_affect_result
unit_tests.description: All three required stages succeeded plus one unrecognized extra stage entry still returns False.
